Admins can now create teams from a new Teams page at `/app/teams`. I haven't run tests, lint, type-check or the app, as you asked, so none of this has been executed.

- **Create-team API:** `features/teams/api/create-team.ts` has a Zod schema that requires a name and a description. It posts them to `/teams` and refreshes the teams list afterwards.
- **Mock handler:** `POST /teams` in `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` requires you to be logged in and an admin. It saves the team to the mock database.
- **Teams page:** `app/routes/app/teams.tsx` is registered in `app/router.tsx` and `config/paths.ts`. It shows a table of teams (name, description, creation date) and a Create Team button. Non-admins who open the URL see "Only admin can view this."
- **Create form:** `features/teams/components/create-team.tsx` opens the form drawer and shows a "Team Created" success notification after saving.
- **Navigation:** a "Teams" item appears in the dashboard navigation for admins only.

I copied the existing discussions and users code, so it should match the rest of the app.
